snippet.title: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Necrophosis: Full Consciousness is coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Steam on 28th May 2026!

Prepare for a first-person Lovecraftian horror adventure as you step into a nightmarish realm teeming with grotesque forms and ominous visuals. Get ready to explore eerie landscapes, solve unnerving puzzles and uncover secrets in this journey through the macabre. 

Necrophosis: Full Consciousness is a complete experience where you awaken as Consciousness itself before descending into subconsciousness with the included DLC.
